subject: Next steps: security package & buying map for InnoHealth pilot

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai

Subject: Next steps: security package & buying map for InnoHealth pilot

Hi Priya / Michael —

Great to meet you both on the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

Summary of call
- Pilot scope: ingest anonymized clinical notes -> embeddings -> semantic search + summarization (POC, 6 weeks)
- Success criteria: latency < 200ms for retrieval path, relevance P95 > 0.75 on customer eval set, and clear data residency + retention terms
- Stakeholders noted: Priya (CISO sponsor), Michael (Head of Data Product), procurement loop-in for terms

Immediate asks / next steps (action owners)
1) Security evidence pack (SOC 2 redacted, pen-test summary, sample audit logs) — Ben to deliver by end of day Mon 4/12 (ben_carter)
2) Stakeholder map for procurement path and legal signoff — Priya to share list and procurement timeline (priya.desai@innohealth.com)
3) Pricing & mutual action plan (MAP) draft — Ben will send a one-page MAP after evidence delivery
4) Technical kickoff once evidence is accepted — schedule week of 4/19 (tentative)

If that aligns, I will attach our redacted SOC 2 and pen-test summary in my next message and flag internal security for any questions.

Thanks — enjoyed the conversation.

Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0124

Subject: Re: Next steps: security package & buying map for InnoHealth pilot

Ben — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming the timeline looks good. A couple of clarifications from our side: 

Stakeholder / approval path (high level)
- Economic buyer: Michael O'Neal (Head of Data Product)
- Security approver: Me (Priya, CISO) but I will need input from our security engineering team (cc'd procurement here to coordinate legal/contract timeline)
- Procurement / legal: procurement@innohealth.com (they manage master services agreement and SOC attestation requirements)

Evidence checklist we need to review:
- SOC 2 (Type II) or redacted copy suitable for suppliers
- High-level pen test summary (we won't require raw scanner outputs, just findings and remediation status)
- Sample audit logs showing admin access / retention window and log format (CSV or JSON)
- Data retention and deletion policy for customer data (SaaS-hosted inference flow)

Can you include estimated timelines for on-prem / VPC options and whether you support a Data Processing Addendum (DPA) with EU data residency? Not required for pilot but useful to know.

Priya
CISO, InnoHealth

Priya / Michael — attaching the redacted items we discussed. See notes below.

Attachments:
- InnoHealth_SOC2_redacted.pdf (redacted SOC 2 Type II report, summary of controls)
- innohealth_pen_test_summary_v1.pdf (third-party pentest summary, high-level findings + remediation dates)
- sample_audit_logs_20270411.csv (example admin + inference logs, truncated)

Delivery notes: 
- SOC 2: redacted copy is safe to share with procurement; full trust report can be provided under NDA if needed.
- Pen test: summary includes severity classification and whether issues are closed; full report available on NDA.
- Audit logs: the sample contains timestamps, user role, API key id (hashed), and operation type. Retention default is 90 days for hosted; Dedicated/Private options allow custom retention (can be configured to customer's policy).

Answers to Priya's questions: 
- VPC / Private deployment: supported, delivery lead time for pilot depends on infra and contract — ballpark 4–6 weeks for a dedicated VPC pilot with current capacity.
- DPA & EU residency: we do provide a DPA and regional deployments (EU regions); we'll loop Legal when terms solidify.

Next: I will send a 1-page MAP by 4/13 outlining milestones, acceptance criteria, and responsibilities. Marissa (security) is cc'd — she can field any questions on the SOC/pen items.

Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: procurement@innohealth.com
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@innohealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-13T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood evidence + questions on retention / encryption

Hi InnoHealth procurement team —

Ben shared the initial redacted SOC 2 and pen-test summary. I'm Marissa on Redwood's security team; looping in to answer a couple of frequent procurement asks so you have quick references while Priya reviews: 

1) Encryption at rest / in transit: AES-256 at rest; TLS 1.3 in transit. KMS options available for Dedicated/Private deployments. 
2) Audit logs: sample provided earlier. Logs show API key id hashed; full log exports can be provided as CSV/JSON via secure transfer during contract stage.
3) Retention policy: hosted default 90 days; Dedicated/Private: configurable. We can offer contractual retention SLAs for Dedicated customers (e.g., 365 days) — specify desired window and we will confirm feasibility.
4) Pen-test follow-up: findings with medium severity were remediated in Jan 2027 and verified by the third-party vendor (see attached summary). Full report can be shared under NDA.

If procurement has a preferred template for security attestations or an evidence checklist, please send it and I'll map our artifacts to your template.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Security Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: none in this message (referencing earlier files)

Thanks Ben / Marissa — this is helpful. Two quick technical questions before we surface to procurement: 

1) Can you confirm the retention and deletion flow for inference artifacts (embeddings, KV cache, model outputs)? We need to know what is held and for how long by default and what controls we have to purge data on demand.
2) Audit logs: can we get an example format that shows user attribution and API key references (redacted IDs are fine)? We want to confirm our SIEM ingest path.

If both are straightforward, I'll move this to procurement for contract and timeline alignment.

-Michael
Head of Data Product, InnoHealth
